description: This file defines the AzureSSO class for handling Azure Single Sign-On (SSO) integration, including login, callback, token refresh, and configuration setup using passport and OpenID Connect strategies.

classes.name: AzureSSO
classes.description: A class extending SSOBase to implement Azure Active Directory Single Sign-On functionality, including configuration, login flow, token management, and testing setup.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the SSO provider, 'Microsoft SSO'.

methods.name: getCallbackURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the callback URL for Azure SSO based on environment variables.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up Express routes for login and callback endpoints, handling Azure SSO authentication flow.

methods.name: setSSOConfig
methods.description: Configures the SSO strategy with provided settings, including setting up the OpenID Connect strategy with Azure AD endpoints.

methods.name: testSetup
methods.description: Performs a test request to Azure AD token endpoint to verify configuration credentials.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Requests a new access token from Azure AD using a refresh token.
